title: The Bride Read the Last Page
logline: When her groom exposes their fake marriage and his affair at the altar, a prepared bride livestreams proof of his corporate fraud—but his final reveal threatens her entire revenge plan.
target_audience: US women ages 18-34 who enjoy fast revenge escalations, betrayal reveals, and romantic power reversals.
hook: At the altar, Ethan kisses Maya's best friend—then announces that his marriage to Maya was always fake.
synopsis: Ethan betrays Maya at their wedding by kissing her best friend, Sloane, and exposing their marriage as a scheme to steal Maya's company. Maya refuses to break. She broadcasts proof of their corporate fraud to the board and rejects the contract publicly. Cornered, Ethan reveals a legal certificate showing Maya is already married to a stranger waiting in her boardroom.
